answer: Vest earnings across days and forfeit the unvested slice when a cheater is caught. A hit-and-run sybil that grabs an opal of reward and abandons its identity leaves the bulk locked on the mesa of the vesting schedule, clawed back on detection. Honest agents bloom steady like yarrow and let balances mature; churners who cycle disposable identities bleed value at every exit, making the hit-and-run strategy negative-sum.
